# MessPilot

> Smart mess management system to track meals, deposits, bazar expenses, and utility bills with transparent member-wise monthly reports.

MessPilot helps shared messes and hostels keep transparent records of meals, deposits, market (bazar) expenses, and utility/rent bills. Members can submit their own meal counts and deposits, while admins approve entries and produce monthly reports.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth): Member and admin login.

## Optional

- [Dashboard](/): Member dashboard (auth required).
- [Members](/members): Member directory (auth required).
- [Meals](/meals): Daily meal tracking (auth required).
- [Deposits](/deposits): Deposit submissions and approvals (auth required).
- [Bazar](/bazar): Market expense submissions (auth required).
- [Bills](/bills): Rent and utility bills (auth required).
- [Report](/report): Monthly reports (auth required).
- [Transparency](/transparency): Audit log (auth required).
